1. Short title, extent and commencement.—(1) This Act may be called the Azad Jammu and Kashmir Finance Act, 2023. (2) It extends to the whole of Azad Jammu and Kashmir. (3) It shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.—In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context, Government means the Government of Azad Jammu and Kashmir and prescribed means prescribed by rules made under this Act.
3. Levy of tax.—The Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, levy a tax on the services specified for this purpose and shall provide for the collection of that tax.
